title: RZ 300e Premium
sources:
- Lexus RZ specs: https://www.lexus.com/models/RZ
- EPA: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/Find.do?action=sbs&id=46519
- IIHS: https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/lexus/rz-4-door-suv/2025
driverAssistBrand: Lexus Safety System+ 3.0 / Lexus Teammate (Advanced Drive on select trims)
adasStandard: Lexus Safety System+ 3.0: Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Full-Speed Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Lane Tracing Assist, Road Sign Assist, Intelligent High Beams. Source: https://www.lexus.com/safety
adasOptional: Available: Advanced Park (auto parking), Traffic Jam Assist (Level 2 hands-free below 25 mph), Panoramic View Monitor. Source: https://www.lexus.com/models/RZ/features
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear view camera with dynamic gridlines. Backup camera washer available. Source: https://www.lexus.com/models/RZ
sideViewCameraNotes: Panoramic View Monitor (360-degree camera) available on Premium and standard on Luxury. No dedicated side-view (Honda LaneWatch-style) camera. Source: https://www.lexus.com/models/RZ
subscriptionFeatures: Lexus Drive Connect (cloud nav, intelligent assistant): 1-year trial, then ~$25/mo. Remote Connect (remote start, lock/unlock): 1-year trial, then $80/yr or $8/mo. Safety Connect (SOS, automatic collision notification): 10-year trial. Wi-Fi Connect: 1-month/3GB trial, then paid via AT&T. Source: https://www.lexus.com/connected-services
drmNotes: Vehicle operates fully without internet for core driving functions. Cloud Navigation, Drive Connect, and Remote Connect require active subscription after trial. OTA updates require connectivity. Sources: https://www.lexus.com/connected-services
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving kill switch installed in MY2025 production. Lexus has not announced specifics on the upcoming federal mandate implementation. Camera-based driver monitoring is part of the Lexus Safety System+ 3.0 ADAS package but not used to disable the vehicle. Source: https://www.lexus.com/safety
knownIssues: Reports of charging speeds slower than advertised in cold weather. Early software bugs in Lexus Interface infotainment have been addressed via OTA. Range below EPA estimate in cold/highway use. Sources: https://www.insideevs.com/reviews/lexus-rz-450e/ , https://forums.lexus.com/
recalls: No major recalls specific to 2025 RZ as of 2026-05. Check NHTSA for current: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Varies by state. CA CVRP wound down 2023. Some states (CO, NJ, NY) offer rebates $2,000-7,500. Source: https://www.energy.gov/eere/electricvehicles/electric-vehicles-tax-credits-and-other-incentives
